<includeonly>{{JCFCite|url=posts/29290174|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2008-10-12|time=2:26 PM|accessdate=2025-08-06|quote=I'd call Gendrah-Narvin and Erhynradd star systems -- I err on the side of star systems unless there's evidence to the contrary.}} <small>(In reply to: "Jason, is Gendrah-Narvin a city country, star, or planet?")</small> {{#if:{{{legends|}}}|[[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], co-authors of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''
|[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and a number of maps in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] (see a list [[Template:Planetnamia|here]]), and his ''Atlas'' co-author [[Daniel Wallace]]}}, stated their intention to create the approximate locations for numerous events based on context implied from their names. Given this principle, this article makes a similar basic assumption for {{{event|}}} in relation to {{#if:{{{system|}}}|the {{{system|}}}|{{{location|}}}}}.</includeonly><noinclude>
This template is to be used for referencing the rationale, based on [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]'s comments on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] on [[TheForce.net]], for treating [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and locations that share their name with battles or events as being the approximate location of said event.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article. Fill in the required fields and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Battlenamia|event=|system=|location=|legends=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|event}} &mdash; Linked (or partially linked; see examples below) name of the event.
*Either of the following:
**'''system''': Linked (or partially linked; see examples below) name of the system.
**'''location''': Linked (or partially linked; see examples below) name of the location.

===Optional parameters===
*'''legends''': Use this parameter with the value "1" for [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars Legends]] subjects.
**Parameter not needed for [[canon]] subjects related to the following sources:
***[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]
***''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''
***''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''
***{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}}
***{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}

===Examples===
<code><nowiki>{{Battlenamia|event=[[Erhynradd Mutiny]]|system=Erhynradd [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Battlenamia|event=[[Erhynradd Mutiny]]|system=Erhynradd [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Battlenamia|event=Erhynradd Mutiny|system=[[Erhynradd system/Legends|Erhynradd system]]|legends=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Battlenamia|event=Erhynradd Mutiny|system=[[Erhynradd system/Legends|Erhynradd system]]|legends=1}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Battlenamia|event=Battle of Kromus|system=[[Kromus system]]}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Battlenamia|event=Battle of Kromus|system=[[Kromus system]]}}
